headline: SpaceX listed on Nasdaq with 18,712 BTC on its books; bitcoin barely moved that day
what_happened: SpaceX priced the largest IPO ever at $135 a share on 11 Jun (555.6 million shares, $75 billion raised, a $1.77 trillion valuation) and began trading on Nasdaq as SPCX on 12 Jun, opening at $150. Its S-1 (filed 20 May) showed 18,712 BTC, more than Tesla's 11,509. BTC rose 3.4% on 11 Jun, which CoinDesk tied to soft US core inflation and an Iran headline, then closed listing day flat (-0.1%).

headline: BTC jumped 7% the day Trump pushed the crypto Clarity Act
what_happened: At a White House event with crypto CEOs, Trump told Congress to pass "a fair version of the Clarity Act". Bitcoin rose 7.1% that day (64,725 to 69,335). Reuters and CNBC also credit a Treasury bond-buyback move and a short squeeze, so his words were one push of several.

headline: BTC fell 4.1% the day about $6.3B was hacked out of Binance
what_happened: Late on 29 Oct (UTC) Binance reported a security breach; about 6.3 billion USD moved out in about 20 minutes (TRM Labs). Binance said user funds are safe and it would cover all losses. A hawkish Fed and a Nasdaq selloff also weighed that day.

headline: June 2026: $16.1B of crypto bets liquidated, the biggest month of H1
what_happened: BTC fell from 73,674 (1 Jun open) to 59,131 (5 Jun low) on Binance. CoinGlass counted 1.833 billion USD of liquidations on 5 Jun and 16.14 billion USD in June, about 70% of it long positions.
